add.title: Servex: unload whisper-server and recite python after ~30 min unused, start them on demand
add.why: They hold the model in memory all day (whisper alone is ~14 s to reload). Needs a start-on-demand call in the Dictate and recite clients first; without it, unloading breaks the next dictation. Not built in the process-cleanup task for that reason.

add.title: Servex: make the start_server MCP call carry the calling agent so a server it starts is owned by that agent's task
add.why: start_server runs under Servex, so the new server records Servex as its owner and closeout() cannot stop it for the task that asked. Servers started by worktree-up.mjs and by scripts are owned correctly already.

add.title: Tunnel: keep only the newest tunnel per name
add.why: Server/Tunnel.mjs only blocks a second launch (claim state file); a stale tunnel of the same name from an earlier run still keeps running until the sweep sees it as stale.

add.title: merge.mjs leaves the merged worktree's dev server running
add.why: A hand-made worktree (pc-merge) merged with merge.mjs kept its smoke/dev server alive, so git removed it from its list but the folder stayed on disk with files being regenerated until the server was stopped by hand. merge.mjs should run Lifecycle.closeout on the folder (stop its servers) before removing it, and fail loudly if anything is left.

add.title: Pool worktrees get dirtied by their own server's files.jsonl watcher, so close_task refuses to return them
add.why: 2026-11-06: after merging qf-4, git status showed 145 changed files: about 135 files.jsonl rewritten by the worktree's own dev-server watcher (Server/plugins/PageFiles.js), plus probe-written records. They regenerated within seconds of a checkout, so close_task said 'uncommitted changes' until a second reset raced it. Either ignore files.jsonl in pool worktrees' dirty check, or don't run the watcher on pool servers.

add.title: One STANDING agent list in a small SDK-free module, imported by Agents.js, Processes.js and Relief.js; Lifecycle agent close rows carry rss mb
add.why: The relief review (2026-11-06) found the STANDING regex copied three times (Agents.js:1243, Processes.js:267, Relief.js). An edit to one misses the others. Relief's freed_mb_estimate also runs low, because Lifecycle agent rows have no mb.

add.title: OpenItems.after_write: run off the synchronous write_line path (or replay incrementally)
add.why: measured 2026-11-06 by minion-score-endings-2: one close on session-e00f55c9/session.jsonl (3.7 MB) blocks Servex 0.5-1.9 s, because the rule replays the whole record inside the synchronous TaskLoop.write_line; small records are fast, big ones stall every agent for that moment

add.title: SessionFolders.url: take the last /public/ in the path (or path.relative against <repo>/public)
add.why: score-endings review 3 #6: it takes the first /public/, so a checkout under a parent folder named public (C:/x/public/monorepo/) gives a wrong url

add.title: leaks.mjs: mark a start line whose Servex died as 'ended with its Servex', not 'gone, end missed'
add.why: After each Servex crash, its children (procmon powershell, nvidia-smi, fixer claude.exe) have no end line because no exit event can fire after the parent dies. They show as 'end missed' (7 of 15 open on 2026-11-07), which hides a real missed end among them. A start line from a Servex pid that has since been replaced can be classed separately.

add.title: Adopt live worktree servers at boot, so stop_idle can stop them
add.why: Measured 2026-11-09 (mastermind-resources/dev-server-count/measure.json): 8 real dev servers ran but list_servers and procs/*.json knew 1. The 7 others (qf-1..6 and a worktree-up server) started under an earlier Servex or by worktree-up.mjs and were never re-adopted, so their registry status reads 'stopped'. Worktrees.stop_idle skips a runner whose status is 'stopped', so an idle non-pool worktree server in that state is never stopped. Fix: at boot (and on the worktree tick), match live node run.js/server.js processes to .worktrees.json by path and adopt their pid.

add.title: closeout.test.mjs times out in every merge gate
add.why: 2026-11-09: it hit the 60 s cap on all three merge runs of runaway-search and dev-server-count (merge.mjs counts it as no result, so it never blocks, and never proves anything either). Find what it waits on under load, or give it its own longer cap.
